name: rrf-lsp-vscode
description: Language support, hover documentation and more for RepRapFirmware (Duet3D) G-code files.
author: remenod

rrfgcode.activateOnGenericGcode.description: Enable LSP for generic non RRF gcode files

rrfgcode.argCheck.enabled.description: Master switch for argument validation of G/M/T commands. When false, no per-argument checks (including path existence) run.

rrfgcode.argCheck.paths.enabled.description: Warn when a string-literal path argument (e.g. M98 P"sys/foo.g") refers to a file that does not exist on the SD-card root.

rrfgcode.argCheck.parameters.enabled.description: Warn about a G/M/T parameter letter the command does not read, report a letter the command needs that is missing (e.g. M42 without S), and check numbers written without braces (e.g. M106 P-1, G4 P1.5), as RepRapFirmware reads them.

rrfgcode.argCheck.paths.ignore.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns (forward slashes, relative to the SD-card root) for paths that should NOT trigger 'file not found' warnings.

Supported patterns:
- `sys/legacy.g` — exact file
- `macros/**` — entire subtree
- `macros/*.g` — direct children only
- `{old,new}/*.g` — alternation

Paths are workspace-relative on purpose, so the setting stays portable when the project is moved or shared via version control.

rrfgcode.maxLineLength.markdownDescription:
Report an error when a command exceeds this many bytes. Only the command part counts — indentation, `N` line numbers, `*` checksums and `;` comments are excluded, because RepRapFirmware never stores them in its G-code input buffer.

The default matches current firmware (256-byte buffer including the terminator → 255 usable bytes). Older RRF 3.0–3.3 builds only accept 100–160 bytes, so lower the limit if you target them.

Set to `0` to disable the check.

rrfgcode.typeCheck.enabled.markdownDescription: Report expressions that RepRapFirmware would reject at runtime because of their types — `"a" + 1`, `if 1`, `abs("x")`, indexing a number, and so on. Only definite errors are reported: when any possible type of an operand works, nothing is shown.

rrfgcode.sbc.markdownDescription: The printer runs with a single-board computer (DuetSoftwareFramework). Its object-model fields (`sbc`, `plugins`, `job.layers`, …) are then known; without one they do not exist and are reported as unknown paths.

enumDescriptions: No target: everything the newest firmware knows is accepted
rrfgcode.rrfVersion.markdownDescription: Target RepRapFirmware line. Functions added later (`round`, `take`, `drop`, `find`, `square` need 3.6) are reported as unknown on an older line.

scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ..
